mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are mainly clear over Verona City Hall with a temperature of 70 degrees and a beautiful waxing crescent moon visible. We are looking at an overnight low of 69 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center has several volunteer openings available for those willing to commit to at least two shifts per month. Please remember that some roles involve physical activity, and volunteers must maintain participant confidentiality.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market, while tomorrow features the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds and a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
On August 6, an officer arrested a 49-year-old driver for an O W I fourth offence after observing erratic driving.
Today's delicious flavor is Turtle, and with the store closing in less than one hour, you have just enough time to grab a scoop before they lock the doors.
